scope: Engineering dependency gate on six exposed original development pairs. Full official query encoder and full original operational contract; no novelty, natural-defect gold, speedup or up-to-bound equivalence claim.
row_bound_semantics: Every physical table has exactly two live rows; not each table at most two, not an unbounded equivalence result.

contract_definition.primary: All key components non-NULL; tuples of key values unique.
contract_definition.foreign: Each source value has a target match under strict non-NULL equality; nullable SQL FK semantics are not substituted.
contract_definition.gte_column_integer: All source rows have a non-NULL value at least the literal.
contract_definition.neq_column_column: Every Cartesian pair across the two entire columns is non-NULL and unequal; not a same-row SQL CHECK.

dialect: Official DIALECT.ALL for original query compilation; concrete replay is explicitly SQLite only.
external_guard_requirement: Parent enforces monotonic whole-process wall deadline <=25s with termination independent of Python callbacks, sampled RSS <=256 MiB, and single worker. Python SIGALRM may be delayed inside native code. Parent records complete process wall and resource/termination outcomes, including startup before Budget creation and all failed/incomplete attempts.
cleanup_accounting: cleanup COMPLETE means official __exit__ returned, not proof all objects were freed. Local references can survive until run_case returns; total worker CPU/RSS and parent process accounting cover them.
baseline: Unmodified official Environment/Scope/Verifier/compare from locked source, with complete original schema/C; old v5 narrow bridge and aggregate recognizer are not involved.
instrumentation: Official analyze temporarily captures its compare inputs; the original compare is then invoked with a transparent solver delegate that records the actual check and enforces timeout. No official formula rewriting, IC removal or query rewriting.
nonempty_gate: A separate 500ms solver checks the entire exact-shape original operational C before query encoding; UNSAT/UNKNOWN stop query work and are not equivalence successes.
sat_validation: Check model satisfies all original submitted facts and official query assertions; decode complete physical database; independently validate full operational C; replay both unchanged SQL in SQLite. Only registered semantic intersection can yield VALIDATED_SAT_SQLITE_INTERSECTION.

dev_01.reason: Bare columns/SELECT * under GROUP BY have implementation-dependent representative semantics; keep SQLite replay and reverse insertion control, mark DIALECT_UNKNOWN.

dev_02.reason: Equality/group/count/distinct with non-NULL strings and explicit official all-cross neq profile; compare result bags, retain original ORDER BY.

dev_03.reason: AVG vs integer SUM/COUNT division and ROUND is the already exposed dialect control; any difference is DIALECT_UNKNOWN, never an advantage or natural-defect success.

dev_04.reason: INT32 keys, strict non-NULL FK, NOT IN vs natural-left-join/count; a nullable FK poison witness is invalid under this profile.

dev_05.reason: Account and name are separate PKs, so bare name grouping is functionally determined; equality/group/INT32 SUM under exact two rows remains within int64.

dev_06.reason: Strict FK excludes unmatched BOXES; nonnegative INT32 counts with two rows and SUM/add/IFNULL remain int64 safe.

failure_policy: All parse/unsupported/IC/nonempty/query-unknown/replay/dialect/budget/monitor failures and remaining NOT_RUN slots retain denominator and all incurred costs. ALL_SIX_ATTEMPTS_RETURNED is execution status, never semantic PASS.
optional_calcite149_control: Not registered or executed in this six-case worker. A separate explicit exposed engineering-control protocol is required, full six-table schema/C intact, exact n=1; its existing eager aggregation rewrite is not a new natural test.
future_fusion_gate: Run and inspect this official baseline before implementing or evaluating shared legal probe pool ordering plus official fallback. All fused/baseline arms must share identical legal probe pool and total budget; dev03 excluded from success metrics.
